requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B and C.
User wants the property located near public transport. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

A university student residence must be close to schools and universities. Education is essential to the project type, so the threshold is the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters ESTATES to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili', the filterable equivalent of tipologia_bene_immobile) with surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using haversine_km on latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance to that point. The capacity of 60 people and the CDP/PNRR program have no matching filterable column, so they are not applied.
